website.error: Diagnostics / life-science instruments company — no proprietary drug pipeline page

commercial_product.description: Bio-Rad operates two segments: (1) Life Science (instruments, reagents and consumables for proteomics, genomics, cell biology, food safety, and process chromatography — Droplet Digital PCR, ddSEQ single-cell, qPCR, Western blotting, flow cytometry, electrophoresis), and (2) Clinical Diagnostics (quality controls, blood-typing, immunohematology, autoimmune, diabetes monitoring HbA1c, infectious disease, BioPlex multiplex testing platforms). It manufactures instruments, reagents and IVDs — not therapeutic drugs.

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Bio-Rad is a life-science research and clinical diagnostics company that manufactures laboratory instruments, reagents, and in vitro diagnostic (IVD) products. It does not develop or sponsor proprietary therapeutic drugs. No Bio-Rad-sponsored P1/P2/P3 interventional drug trials are listed on ClinicalTrials.gov.
